en.headline: Hong Kong records 4.5 million visitor arrivals in July, up 3%
en.dek: The Tourism Board said major MICE events supported growth while several days of wet weather moderated the rise in mainland arrivals; first-seven-month total reached 31.22 million.
body: Hong Kong recorded about 4.5 million visitor arrivals in July, a 3 per cent increase from a year earlier, the Hong Kong Tourism Board said on Monday.

Mainland visitors accounted for roughly 3.61 million of the total, also up 3 per cent. The board said growth from the mainland market moderated mainly because of several days of inclement weather during the month. The Hong Kong Observatory had described July as much gloomier and wetter than usual, with total rainfall more than double the normal.

Long-haul markets rose 17 per cent to about 307,000 arrivals, while short-haul markets fell 9 per cent. The board attributed the short-haul decline in part to higher fuel costs linked to the situation in the Middle East and resulting adjustments in flight capacity.

A series of major international meetings, incentives, conventions and exhibitions, including the 108th Lions International Convention and the technology exhibition LEAP East, helped drive business and MICE visitor numbers, the board said.

For the first seven months of 2026, cumulative arrivals reached about 31.22 million, an 11 per cent year-on-year increase. The board said it would continue to stage mega events to attract more visitors.

zh.headline: 7月訪港旅客450萬人次 按年升3%
zh.dek: 旅發局指大型會展活動帶動增長，惡劣天氣令內地客升幅放緩；首七個月累計3,122萬人次，升11%。
body: 香港旅遊發展局今日公布，7月初步訪港旅客錄得約450萬人次，按年上升3%。
當中內地旅客約361萬人次，同樣按年升3%。旅發局表示，內地市場增長步伐有所放緩，主要受7月多日惡劣天氣影響。天文台早前指7月天氣較往常陰暗多雨，總雨量超過正常一倍。
長途市場升17%至約30.7萬人次，短途市場則跌9%。旅發局指短途市場受中東局勢令燃油成本上升及航班運力調整等因素影響。
旅發局又指，包括第108屆國際獅子會年會及科技展覽LEAP East在內的一系列大型國際會議、獎勵旅遊、會議及展覽活動，帶動商務及會展旅客增長。
今年首七個月累計訪港旅客約3,122萬人次，按年增加11%。旅發局表示會繼續舉辦大型活動吸引旅客。
